title: Former table tennis player Kasumi Ishikawa announces marriage; sports world celebrates the good news from the three-time Olympic medalist
summary: Former table tennis player Kasumi Ishikawa has announced her marriage, receiving messages of congratulations from many associates and fans.

title: Man stabbed to death at Fukuoka City train station bike parking; police pursue suspect on the run
summary: A stabbing incident at a bike parking area at a train station in Fukuoka City has left a man dead, and the armed suspect is on the run heading south.

title: China launches manned spacecraft 'Shenzhou 24' with first foreign crew member, emphasizing international cooperation
summary: China launched the manned spacecraft 'Shenzhou 24' carrying a Pakistani astronaut and others, highlighting international collaboration.

title: US Democratic Party wins big in House elections with 259 seats, surpassing 1992 results
summary: The US Democratic Party has significantly increased its seat count in the House of Representatives, positioning itself to become the largest majority of this century.

title: Kaima Taira reaches agreement with Blue Jays; US media reports a large 5-year, approx. 12.7 billion yen contract
summary: Pitcher Kaima Taira, who had been utilizing the posting system from the Seibu Lions, has reached an agreement for a Major League move.

title: Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation Deputy President Toshihiro Michioka to become next representative secretary of Kansai Association of Corporate Executives
summary: Toshihiro Michioka, Deputy President of Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation, is expected to assume the position of the next representative secretary of the Kansai Association of Corporate Executives.

title: Corporate service prices rose 4.2% in October, marking the highest level in 36 and a half years
summary: Driven by factors such as international freight transport, corporate service prices in October showed significant growth.
